title: LLMs as Sources of Information in Dermatology
summary: Artificial intelligence is increasingly being used to obtain information about health and disease. The aim of the study is to investigate whether and how patients with chronic inflammatory skin diseases, skin tumors, or allergological diseases use artificial intelligence-based language model applications in relation to their current condition. The study also assesses reasons for use or non-use and the perceived impact on understanding of the disease and its treatment, as well as on communication with physicians. Participation consists of completing an anonymous questionnaire once and takes approximately 15 minutes.
conditions: chronic inflammatory skin diseases, dermato-oncological diseases, and allergological diseases

interventions.name: Single participation in a non-interventional cross-sectional study at the Department of Dermatology, Venereology and Allergology, University Medical Center Leipzig, involving adult patients with chronic inflammatory skin diseases, dermato-oncological diseases, or allergological diseases. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patient at the Department of Dermatology, Venereology and Allergology, University Medical Center Leipzig, with a dermato-oncological disease, chronic inflammatory skin disease, or allergological disease.
Exclusion criteria:
Persons who are unable to provide informed consent or complete the questionnaire independently due to cognitive impairment, impaired consciousness, insufficient German language proficiency, or other relevant circumstances are excluded from participation.
